# Nuclear Power Research

Section: Research Path > Unlocked by

## Nuclear Power

[![Genericresearch](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/1/11/Genericresearch.png/revision/latest?cb=20240421181620)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/1/11/Genericresearch.png/revision/latest?cb=20240421181620)

### Research Points

30

### Research Time

1h 40m

## Research Path

### Unlocked by

[Industrial Equipment](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Industrial_Equipment_Research), [Steam Power](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Steam_Power_Research)

Nuclear power is a [researchable](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Research) item which unlocks the following components:

| Category | Component |
| --- | --- |
| Industry | Nuclear Control Rod |
| Industry | Nuclear Fuel Assembly |
| Industry | Nuclear Fuel Rod |
| [Sensors](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Sensors) | Radiation Detector |
| Specialist Equipment | Equipment Inventory (Radiation Detector) |
| Specialist Equipment | Outfit Inventory (Hazmat) |
